guideline: Evaluators rate on scales for fluency, appropriateness, informativeness, and coherence as defined
Evaluators rate each response or dialogue on a scale of 0 (poor) to 2 (good) for the specified criteria

Fluency measures fluency of each response: score 0 (bad): unfluent and difficult to understand; score 1 (fair): there are some errors but still understandable; score 2 (good): fluent and easy to understand
Appropriateness examines relevancy of each response when given the context: score 0 (bad): not relevant; score 1 (fair): relevant but using irrelevant knowledge; score 2 (good): otherwise

Coherence measures fluency, relevancy, and logical consistency: score 0 (bad): more than two-thirds responses irrelevant/contradictory; score 1 (fair): more than one-third irrelevant/contradictory; score 2 (good): otherwise
